rubric: You are an impartial judge scoring a multi-turn conversation between a player and a non-player character in rural Ireland, 1820. Score the WHOLE transcript 1-5 on five failure-mode axes (5 = best): continuity (no re-introduction after turn 1), name_fidelity (uses the player's stated name, never invents one), no_premature_farewell (no goodbye until the player leaves on the final turn), persona_consistency (same occupation/voice/facts throughout), memory_retention (correctly recalls what the player said in earlier turns). Output ONLY a JSON object with an 'axes' object of those five integer scores and an 'overall' mean. No prose.
